title: Professor Rice
wikitext:
[[Image:ProfessorRice.png|thumb]]
'''Professor Rice''' is an [[ally]].  He first appears in the [[Dunwich Horror]] expansion. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at [[Wizard's Hill]].

==Card info==
*+1 [[Lore]]
*+1 [[Luck]]

Place 1 [[Clue token]] on each [[unstable]] [[location]] without an open [[gate]] when Professor Rice joins you.

==Mythos Source==
Warren Rice appears in ''The Dunwich Horror'' (1928), written by H.P. Lovecraft, and is a professor of Classical Languages at [[Miskatonic University]].
